```sql
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_SALES"
    WHERE "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
),
traffic_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        SUM("GLANCE_VIEWS")         AS "TOTAL_GLANCE_VIEWS"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_TRAFFIC"
    WHERE "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
),
inventory_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        SUM("SELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS")                     AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS",
        SUM("SELLABLE_ON_HAND_INVENTORY")                 AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE",
        SUM("NET_RECEIVED_UNITS")                         AS "TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
        SUM("NET_RECEIVED")                               AS "TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_VALUE",
        SUM("OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY")               AS "TOTAL_OPEN_PO_QUANTITIES",
        SUM("UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS")            AS "TOTAL_UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
        AVG("VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE")                   AS "AVG_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
        AVG("RECEIVE_FILL_RATE")                          AS "AVG_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
        AVG("SELL_THROUGH_RATE")                          AS "AVG_SELL_THROUGH_RATE"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_INVENTORY"
    WHERE "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
),
net_ppm_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        AVG("NET_PPM")                 AS "AVG_NET_PPM"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_NET_PPM"
    WHERE "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
),
product_catalog AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "ASIN",
        "PRODUCT_TITLE"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."PRODUCT_CATALOG"
)
SELECT
    s."DATE"                                                AS "REPORT_DATE",
    p."PRODUCT_TITLE"                                       AS "PRODUCT_TITLE",
    s."ASIN"                                                AS "ASIN",
    s."PROGRAM"                                             AS "PROGRAM",
    s."PERIOD"                                              AS "PERIOD",
    s."TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS"                                 AS "ORDERED_UNITS",
    s."TOTAL_ORDERED_REVENUE"                               AS "ORDERED_REVENUE",
    ROUND(s."TOTAL_ORDERED_REVENUE" / NULLIF(s."TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS", 0), 4)
                                                            AS "AVG_SELLING_PRICE",
    t."TOTAL_GLANCE_VIEWS"                                  AS "GLANCE_VIEWS",
    ROUND(s."TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS" / NULLIF(t."TOTAL_GLANCE_VIEWS", 0), 4)
                                                            AS "CONVERSION_RATE",
    s."TOTAL_SHIPPED_UNITS"                                 AS "SHIPPED_UNITS",
    s."TOTAL_SHIPPED_REVENUE"                               AS "SHIPPED_REVENUE",
    n."AVG_NET_PPM"                                         AS "AVG_NET_PPM",
    i."TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS"                                 AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS",
    i."TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE"                                 AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE",
    i."TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_UNITS"                            AS "NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
    i."TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_VALUE"                            AS "NET_RECEIVED_VALUE",
    i."TOTAL_OPEN_PO_QUANTITIES"                            AS "OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITIES",
    i."TOTAL_UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS"               AS "UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
    i."AVG_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE"                        AS "AVG_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
    i."AVG_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE"                               AS "AVG_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
    i."AVG_SELL_THROUGH_RATE"                               AS "AVG_SELL_THROUGH_RATE"
FROM sales_data s
LEFT JOIN traffic_data t
    ON s."DATE" = t."DATE"
   AND s."ASIN" = t."ASIN"
   AND s."PROGRAM" = t."PROGRAM"
   AND s."PERIOD" = t."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN inventory_data i
    ON s."DATE" = i."DATE"
   AND s."ASIN" = i."ASIN"
   AND s."PROGRAM" = i."PROGRAM"
   AND s."PERIOD" = i."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN net_ppm_data n
    ON s."DATE" = n."DATE"
   AND s."ASIN" = n."ASIN"
   AND s."PROGRAM" = n."PROGRAM"
   AND s."PERIOD" = n."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN product_catalog p
    ON s."ASIN" = p."ASIN"
ORDER BY
    s."DATE",
    s."ASIN";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Identify all distinct zip codes in Florida from US_ADDRESSES
WITH florida_zips AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "ZIP"
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES"
    WHERE "STATE" = 'FL'
),

-- Step 2: For each Florida zip code, retrieve its polygon (WKT) from GEOGRAPHY_CHARACTERISTICS and compute area
zip_area AS (
    SELECT
        fz."ZIP",
        ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMWKT(gc."VALUE")) AS area_sq_meters
    FROM florida_zips fz
    INNER JOIN "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_CHARACTERISTICS" gc
        ON gc."GEO_ID" = 'zip/' || fz."ZIP"
    WHERE gc."RELATIONSHIP_TYPE" = 'coordinates_wkt'
),

-- Step 3: Pick the zip code with the largest area
largest_zip AS (
    SELECT "ZIP"
    FROM zip_area
    ORDER BY area_sq_meters DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

-- Step 4: From the largest zip code area, select the top 10 addresses with highest latitude
SELECT
    a."NUMBER",
    a."STREET",
    a."STREET_TYPE"
FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES" a
INNER JOIN largest_zip lz ON a."ZIP" = lz."ZIP"
WHERE a."STATE" = 'FL'
ORDER BY a."LATITUDE" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
  -- Step 1: Pre-compute area for all Florida zip code tabulation areas
  florida_zip_areas AS (
    SELECT 
      g."GEO_ID",
      ST_AREA(ST_GEOGRAPHYFROMWKT(gc."VALUE")) AS area
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_INDEX" g
    JOIN "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_CHARACTERISTICS" gc
      ON g."GEO_ID" = gc."GEO_ID"
    WHERE g."LEVEL" = 'CensusZipCodeTabulationArea'
      AND gc."RELATIONSHIP_TYPE" = 'coordinates_wkt'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES" a
        WHERE a."STATE" = 'FL'
          AND a."ID_ZIP" = g."GEO_ID"
      )
  ),
  
  -- Step 2: Find the largest zip code area
  largest_zip AS (
    SELECT "GEO_ID"
    FROM florida_zip_areas
    ORDER BY area DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )

-- Step 3: Get top 10 northernmost addresses in that zip code
SELECT
  a."NUMBER"        AS address_number,
  a."STREET"        AS street_name,
  a."STREET_TYPE"   AS street_type
FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES" a
WHERE a."STATE" = 'FL'
  AND a."ID_ZIP" = (SELECT "GEO_ID" FROM largest_zip)
ORDER BY a."LATITUDE" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH filtered_roads AS (
    SELECT 
        "CLASS",
        "SUBCLASS",
        CASE 
            WHEN "QUADKEY" LIKE '12020210%' THEN 'Amsterdam'
            WHEN "QUADKEY" LIKE '12020211%' THEN 'Rotterdam'
        END AS city,
        TRY_CAST("LENGTH_M" AS DOUBLE) AS length_m
    FROM "NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA"."NETHERLANDS"."V_ROAD"
    WHERE "QUADKEY" LIKE '12020210%' OR "QUADKEY" LIKE '12020211%'
)
SELECT 
    "CLASS",
    "SUBCLASS",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Amsterdam' THEN length_m ELSE 0 END), 4) AS amsterdam_length_m,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Rotterdam' THEN length_m ELSE 0 END), 4) AS rotterdam_length_m
FROM filtered_roads
GROUP BY "CLASS", "SUBCLASS"
ORDER BY "CLASS", "SUBCLASS";
```

```sql
WITH city_geometries AS (
    -- Extract Amsterdam and Rotterdam boundary polygons
    SELECT 
        "NAMES":"local"::STRING AS "city_name",
        "GEO_CORDINATES" AS "boundary_geom"
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ADMINISTRATIVE
    WHERE "ADMIN_LEVEL" = '8'
      AND (LOWER("NAMES":"local") LIKE '%amsterdam%' OR LOWER("NAMES":"local") LIKE '%rotterdam%')
),

road_lengths_by_city AS (
    -- For each road in the specified QUADKEY range, determine which city it belongs to
    SELECT 
        r."CLASS",
        r."SUBCLASS",
        cg."city_name",
        r."LENGTH_M"::FLOAT AS "road_length"
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ROAD r
    CROSS JOIN city_geometries cg
    WHERE (r."QUADKEY" LIKE '12020210%' OR r."QUADKEY" LIKE '12020211%')
      AND ST_INTERSECTS(r."GEO_CORDINATES", cg."boundary_geom")
)

-- Aggregate and pivot the data
SELECT 
    rl."CLASS",
    rl."SUBCLASS",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rl."city_name" = 'Amsterdam' THEN rl."road_length" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Amsterdam",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rl."city_name" = 'Rotterdam' THEN rl."road_length" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Rotterdam"
FROM road_lengths_by_city rl
GROUP BY rl."CLASS", rl."SUBCLASS"
ORDER BY rl."CLASS", rl."SUBCLASS";
```
</details>

```sql
WITH
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Hourly real-time prices from node 10000697078
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
hourly_rt_prices AS (
    SELECT
        "OBJECTID"                                                        AS "price_node_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME")                                    AS "datetime_hour",
        "TIMEZONE",
        ROUND(AVG("LMP"), 4)                                              AS "rtlmp"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."RT_PRICES_RECENT_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000697078
      AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY "OBJECTID", DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME"), "TIMEZONE"
),

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Hourly day-ahead prices from DART_PRICES_SAMPLE (contains RTLMP, not DALMP)
--    We'll use NULL for DALMP since no day-ahead price table is available
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Load, wind, solar forecasts and actuals
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
hourly_forecasts_actuals AS (
    SELECT
        "OBJECTID",
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME")                                    AS "datetime_hour",
        "TIMEZONE",
        MAX("PUBLISHDATE")                                                AS "publish_date",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "DATATYPEID" = 19060 THEN "VALUE" END)              AS "load_forecast",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "DATATYPEID" = 19061 THEN "VALUE" END)              AS "rtload",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "DATATYPEID" = 9285  THEN "VALUE" END)              AS "wind_gen_forecast",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "DATATYPEID" = 16    THEN "VALUE" END)              AS "wind_gen",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "DATATYPEID" = 662   THEN "VALUE" END)              AS "solar_gen_forecast",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "DATATYPEID" = 650   THEN "VALUE" END)              AS "solar_gen"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
      AND "DATATYPEID" IN (19060, 19061, 9285, 16, 662, 650)
      AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY "OBJECTID", DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME"), "TIMEZONE"
),

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Actual loads from RT_LOADS_SAMPLE if available, otherwise use TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
actual_loads_from_rtsample AS (
    SELECT
        "OBJECTID",
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME")                                    AS "datetime_hour",
        "TIMEZONE",
        ROUND(AVG("LMP"), 4)                                              AS "rtload_from_rt"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."RT_PRICES_RECENT_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000697078  -- Note: This is a different OBJECTID, adjust as needed
      AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY "OBJECTID", DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME"), "TIMEZONE"
),

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. Peak classifications
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
peak_classifications AS (
    SELECT
        "MARKETDAY",
        "TIMEZONE",
        "WDPEAK",
        "WEPEAK",
        CASE WHEN "WDPEAK" = 1 OR "WEPEAK" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END         AS "onpeak",
        CASE WHEN "WDPEAK" = 0 AND "WEPEAK" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END        AS "offpeak"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."ISO_MARKET_TIMES_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "MARKETDAY" = '2022-10-01'
),

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. Generate all hours of the day for complete hourly report
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
all_hours AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD('hour', seq.h, '2022-10-01 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS "datetime_hour"
    FROM (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NULL) - 1 AS h
        FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 24))
    ) seq
),

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. Combine all data
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
combined AS (
    SELECT
        'ERCOT'                                                           AS "iso",
        h."datetime_hour"                                                 AS "datetime",
        'CDT'                                                             AS "timezone",  -- CDT for October 1
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Chicago', 'UTC', h."datetime_hour")     AS "datetime_utc",
        p."onpeak",
        p."offpeak",
        p."WEPEAK"                                                        AS "wepeak",
        p."WDPEAK"                                                        AS "wdpeak",
        p."MARKETDAY"                                                     AS "marketday",
        '10000697078'                                                     AS "price_node_name",
        10000697078                                                       AS "price_node_id",
        NULL::NUMBER                                                      AS "dalmp",
        rt."rtlmp",
        'Zone_10000712973'                                                AS "load_zone_name",
        10000712973                                                       AS "load_zone_id",
        f."load_forecast",
        f."publish_date"                                                  AS "load_forecast_publish_date",
        f."rtload"                                                        AS "rtload",
        f."wind_gen_forecast",
        f."publish_date"                                                  AS "wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        f."wind_gen",
        f."solar_gen_forecast",
        f."publish_date"                                                  AS "solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        f."solar_gen",
        ROUND(f."load_forecast" - COALESCE(f."wind_gen_forecast", 0) - COALESCE(f."solar_gen_forecast", 0), 4) AS "net_load_forecast",
        ROUND(COALESCE(f."rtload", 0) - COALESCE(f."wind_gen", 0) - COALESCE(f."solar_gen", 0), 4) AS "net_load_real_time"
    FROM all_hours h
    LEFT JOIN hourly_forecasts_actuals f
        ON h."datetime_hour" = f."datetime_hour"
    LEFT JOIN hourly_rt_prices rt
        ON h."datetime_hour" = rt."datetime_hour"
        AND rt."TIMEZONE" = 'CDT'
    LEFT JOIN peak_classifications p
        ON DATE_TRUNC('day', h."datetime_hour") = p."MARKETDAY"
        AND p."TIMEZONE" = 'CDT'
)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. Final output
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT * FROM combined
ORDER BY "datetime";
```

```sql
-- Report for ERCOT on October 1, 2022 combining hourly price, load, wind, solar data
-- with time zone alignments, peak classifications, and net load calculations

WITH 
-- Generate all 24 hours for Oct 1, 2022 in America/Chicago (Central Daylight Time)
hours AS (
    SELECT 
        DATEADD('hour', seq, '2022-10-01 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS "datetime",
        'America/Chicago' AS "timezone"
    FROM (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 1) - 1 AS seq 
        FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 24))
    ) AS seqs
),

-- Price data from DART_PRICES for node 10000697078
prices AS (
    SELECT 
        dp."DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        dp."TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        dp."DALMP" AS "dalmp",
        dp."RTLMP" AS "rtlmp",
        pn."PNODENAME" AS "price_node_name",
        dp."OBJECTID" AS "price_node_id"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.DART_PRICES_SAMPLE dp
    JOIN YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.PRICE_NODES_SAMPLE pn
        ON dp."OBJECTID" = pn."OBJECTID"
    WHERE dp."OBJECTID" = 10000697078
        AND dp."DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
),

-- Load forecast from TS_FORECAST (datatypeid=19060)
load_forecast AS (

    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 19060
        AND "DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
),

-- Actual load from DART_LOADS (RTLOAD)
actual_load AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",

    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.DART_LOADS_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
),

-- Wind forecast from TS_FORECAST (datatypeid=9285)
wind_forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "wind_gen_forecast",
        "PUBLISHDATE" AS "wind_gen_forecast_publish_date"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 9285
        AND "DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
),

-- Solar forecast from TS_FORECAST (datatypeid=662)
solar_forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "solar_gen_forecast",
        "PUBLISHDATE" AS "solar_gen_forecast_publish_date"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 662
        AND "DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
),

-- Actual wind generation from TS_GEN (datatypeid=16), aggregated to hourly
wind_actual AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME") AS "datetime",
        MODE("TIMEZONE") AS "timezone",
        AVG("VALUE") AS "wind_gen"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.TS_GEN_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 16
        AND "DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME")
),

-- Actual solar generation from TS_GEN (datatypeid=650), aggregated to hourly
solar_actual AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME") AS "datetime",
        MODE("TIMEZONE") AS "timezone",
        AVG("VALUE") AS "solar_gen"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.TS_GEN_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 650
        AND "DATETIME" BETWEEN '2022-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2022-10-01 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', "DATETIME")
),

-- Market times for peak classification
market_times AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "ONPEAK",
        "OFFPEAK",
        "WEPEAK",
        "WDPEAK",
        "MARKETDAY"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.ISO_MARKET_TIMES_SAMPLE
    WHERE "ISO" = 'ERCOT'
        AND "MARKETDAY" = '2022-10-01'
),

-- Load zone info from DS_OBJECT_LIST
load_zone_info AS (
    SELECT 
        "OBJECTID" AS "load_zone_id",
        "OBJECTNAME" AS "load_zone_name"
    FROM YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.DS_OBJECT_LIST_SAMPLE
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
)

-- Main report combining all data
SELECT 
    'ERCOT' AS "iso",
    h."datetime",
    h."timezone",
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(h."timezone", 'UTC', h."datetime"::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS "datetime_utc",
    COALESCE(mt."ONPEAK", 0) AS "onpeak",
    COALESCE(mt."OFFPEAK", 0) AS "offpeak",
    COALESCE(mt."WEPEAK", 0) AS "wepeak",
    COALESCE(mt."WDPEAK", 0) AS "wdpeak",
    mt."MARKETDAY",
    p."price_node_name",
    p."price_node_id",
    p."dalmp",
    p."rtlmp",
    lz."load_zone_name",
    lz."load_zone_id",
    lf."load_forecast",
    lf."load_forecast_publish_date",
    al."rtload",
    wf."wind_gen_forecast",
    wf."wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    wa."wind_gen",
    sf."solar_gen_forecast",
    sf."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    sa."solar_gen",
    ROUND(lf."load_forecast" - COALESCE(wf."wind_gen_forecast", 0) - COALESCE(sf."solar_gen_forecast", 0), 4) AS "net_load_forecast",
    ROUND(al."rtload" - COALESCE(wa."wind_gen", 0) - COALESCE(sa."solar_gen", 0), 4) AS "net_load_real_time"
FROM hours h
LEFT JOIN prices p ON h."datetime" = p."datetime" AND h."timezone" = p."timezone"
LEFT JOIN load_forecast lf ON h."datetime" = lf."datetime" AND h."timezone" = lf."timezone"
LEFT JOIN actual_load al ON h."datetime" = al."datetime" AND h."timezone" = al."timezone"
LEFT JOIN wind_forecast wf ON h."datetime" = wf."datetime" AND h."timezone" = wf."timezone"
LEFT JOIN solar_forecast sf ON h."datetime" = sf."datetime" AND h."timezone" = sf."timezone"
LEFT JOIN wind_actual wa ON h."datetime" = wa."datetime" AND h."timezone" = wa."timezone"
LEFT JOIN solar_actual sa ON h."datetime" = sa."datetime" AND h."timezone" = sa."timezone"
LEFT JOIN market_times mt ON h."datetime" = mt."datetime" AND h."timezone" = mt."timezone"
CROSS JOIN load_zone_info lz
ORDER BY h."datetime";
```
</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH ny_zip_commuters AS (
    SELECT 
        f."ZipCode",
        SUM(f."CensusValueByZip") AS total_commuters_over_1hr
    FROM 
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip" f
    INNER JOIN 
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."LU_GeographyExpanded" g
        ON f."ZipCode" = g."ZipCode"
    WHERE 
        f."MetricID" = 'B08303_011E'
        AND g."PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
    GROUP BY 
        f."ZipCode"
),
top_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        "ZipCode",
        total_commuters_over_1hr
    FROM 
        ny_zip_commuters
    ORDER BY 
        total_commuters_over_1hr DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
state_benchmark AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B08303_011E' THEN "StateBenchmarkValue" END) AS state_benchmark_commuters_over_1hr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B01003_001E' THEN "StateBenchmarkValue" END) AS state_population
    FROM 
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021"
    WHERE 
        "StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
)
SELECT 
    t."ZipCode",
    t.total_commuters_over_1hr,
    sb.state_benchmark_commuters_over_1hr,
    sb.state_population
FROM 
    top_zip t,
    state_benchmark sb;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- CTE to get the top NY zip code for commuters traveling over one hour (MetricID = 'B08303_011E')
WITH top_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        f."ZipCode", 
        f."CensusValueByZip" AS total_commuters
    FROM 
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip" f
    JOIN 
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."LU_GeographyExpanded" g
        ON f."ZipCode" = g."ZipCode"
    WHERE 
        g."PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
        AND f."MetricID" = 'B08303_011E'
    ORDER BY 
        f."CensusValueByZip" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- CTE to extract state-level values for the same metric and total population
state_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B08303_011E' THEN "StateBenchmarkValue" END) AS state_commuters_over_1hr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B01003_001E' THEN "TotalStatePopulation" END) AS state_population
    FROM 
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021"
    WHERE 
        "StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
        AND "MetricID" IN ('B08303_011E', 'B01003_001E')
)
-- Final output including zip code, total commuters, state benchmark, and state population
SELECT 
    t."ZipCode",
    t.total_commuters,
    s.state_commuters_over_1hr,
    s.state_population
FROM 
    top_zip t, 
    state_metrics s;
```
</details>
